lesson: Take turns with a toy: my turn, then your turn.

pages.art: Autumn morning on a sandy beach: the sea as three flat layered bands of blue, soft low waves, a pale sky. Maya, holding her mum's hand, waves at Amir, who sits on the sand. Amir's father sits on a towel close behind him (a background figure, not part of the story). Feeling: a happy surprise, two friends. Calm area: the sky across the top.
Close: one bright red bucket on the sand, exactly between Maya and Amir, who both look at it. Calm area: the plain sand across the bottom.
Maya holds the red bucket to her chest; Amir reaches out for it with both hands, eyes on the bucket. Calm area: the sky across the top.
Tug of war: both children pull the bucket, leaning back; a spray of sand dots flies up between them. Comic and lively, nobody hurt. Calm area: the sky across the top.

Both children sit on the sand crying, mouths open, a few tears; the bucket lies on its side between them. At the edge of the picture, a little snail on the sand peeps out of its round shell, eyes on stalks. Sad but small and safe. Calm area: the sky across the top.

Maya's mum kneels between them and smooths a flat patch of sand with her open hand; she has set the bucket upright in the middle. Both children watch her, tears drying. Feeling: calm returning. Calm area: the sky across the top.
Maya drops a handful of sand into the bucket while Amir waits, his own handful ready. Small arcs of sand show the movement. Calm area: the sky across the top.
Rhythm picture: Maya and Amir kneel facing each other over the bucket, which is now full to the brim; their hands are a soft blur of turns. Both smile. Calm area: the sky across the top.
The bucket has been flipped and lifted: a smooth round sandcastle stands on the sand. Maya and Amir pat its sides; Maya's mum holds the empty bucket up, smiling. Calm area: the sky across the top.
The little snail has climbed to the very top of the sandcastle and stretches its eye stalks up high, a faint shiny trail behind it. Maya and Amir clap, laughing. Calm area: the sky across the top.

Last picture: Maya and Amir both hold the red bucket handle together, ready to fill it again; the sandcastle with the snail on top beside them, waves sliding in as flat bands. Warm and bright. Calm area: the sky across the top.

shots.action: 10 s. Scene 1, the beach. Wide and still: the sea as flat bands, small waves sliding in and out. Hold 3 s, then Maya and her mum walk in. Keep the lower fifth calm for captions.
sound: gentle music: a light tune on a marimba

shots.action: 9 s. Maya sees Amir and waves; Amir waves back from the sand.
8 s. Close on the red bucket on the sand between them. Both look at it. The music stops on one note.
8 s. Maya picks up the bucket and hugs it; Amir reaches for it.
9 s. Scene 2, pull. Tug of war: they pull, lean back, and sand sprays up between them. Both sit down hard on the soft sand. Comic, never rough.
9 s. Both cry, small and short. A little snail peeps out of its shell and looks at them. 2 s of only waves after the line.
10 s. Scene 3, turns. Maya's mum kneels, smooths a patch of sand with her open hand and sets the bucket upright between them. Her voice is calm and kind.
10 s. Maya drops a handful of sand into the bucket (one note), then Amir (another note).
12 s. The turns become music: Maya, Amir, Maya, Amir, one note each, faster and happier, until the bucket is full to the top.
10 s. Mum flips the bucket over; the children pat it twice; Mum lifts it slowly. A round sandcastle stands.
10 s. The snail climbs, slowly and steadily, to the very top of the castle and stretches its eye stalks up high.
8 s. Maya and Amir clap and laugh. No words: a breathing moment.
10 s. Both children take hold of the bucket handle together, not pulling, ready to start again.

14 s. Closing image. Wide: two small figures by the sandcastle, the snail on top, the waves sliding in. Then nothing moves but the gentle waves. Hold 6 s while the music ends, then stop. No autoplay, no next film.
sound: the last note of the tune

steps.picture: A soft toy lies in the middle of a bath towel spread on the floor.
The child holds two corners of the towel and the grown-up holds the other two, facing each other.
Both lift the towel together, low, the toy lying safely in the middle.
They walk slowly across the room, watching each other, towards a mat marked as 'home' by a cushion.
The toy is set down on the home mat; child and grown-up swap sides, smiling.
